description: Official Replicate API schema for google/veo-3.1-lite

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for generation. Doesn't guarantee determinism but slightly improves it.

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image to animate into a video. Ideal images are 16:9 or 9:16 and 1280x720 or 720x1280, depending on the aspect ratio.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Must be 8 when using 1080p resolution.

last_frame.title: Last Frame
last_frame.description: Ending image for interpolation. When provided with an input image, creates a smooth transition between the two images.

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video. 4k is not supported for Veo 3.1 Lite.

title: veo-3.1-lite Input Schema
